english.title: Aid / abet use motor vehicle no test certificate

english.legislation: Contrary to section 47(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
